verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents the separate pieces: APM tracing of every request across microservices, APM agents that collect host and runtime metrics, and centralized log search in Discover. Its overview says it unifies logs, metrics and traces, but nothing describes navigating from a specific span to the logs and metrics tied to it. missing for 10: documented span-to-log correlation (e.g., trace ID linking), a span-to-metrics drill-down workflow, end-to-end request debugging UI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs pinpointing code-level latency.
Unify logs, metrics, traces, user experience data
Elastic APM agents automatically pick up basic host-level metrics and agent-specific metrics
Use **Discover** to search, filter, and tail all your logs ingested into your project in one place.
